verdict.rationale: Fathom's API offers paginated listing of meetings with team filtering (handled by the SDKs), admin access to all users' shared meetings, and webhooks that push content for every new meeting. Together these allow programmatic bulk reads across many recordings, but no documented batch or bulk-action endpoint exists. Missing for 10: batch/bulk write or update endpoints, bulk actions in the UI or MCP, bulk export or delete, and any independent corroboration of bulk workflows.
